text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa has conquered the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
The crowd was in high spirits, and a grand
celebration party was held once again today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'm glad.
Everyone looks so happy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh?
She's standing all alone by the wall over there.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me.
Would you like to chat for a bit, if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Pisa...!?
I'm sorry for making you worry.
I'm fine right here, though.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Um... I can't quite bring myself to celebrate just yet.
To tell the truth, I broke my father's keepsake watch last month.
I'm ashamed to admit it, but I've been crying every night since...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that what happened...?
That is... quite a shame."

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Still, my desire to congratulate you is genuine.
The day you won, my tears just wouldn't stop.
...So, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(So, it's possible to help someone
in this way too, huh...)

—After the party.
Victoire Pisa invited me to go stargazing with her.
As she gazed at the night sky, she suddenly murmured.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
What race do you think we should aim for
after becoming the best in the world?

The value of a race isn't determined by its grade alone.
Looking back through history, you'll find plenty of other 'meaningful victories.'
"That's why I told her... no matter what happens, giving your all in the race right in front of you is what truly matters."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No matter when"... is it? 
I see...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Not everyone is thrilled and excited before a race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (If so, then what I must strive for is already clear.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(As long as there is someone out there,
crushed by sorrow and weeping...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: No matter when, as long as you keep running—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Can I... be of help
in stopping someone's tears?"

She muttered, looking up at the night sky.
Just then... a streak of light shot across the darkness!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...!
A shooting star...

Both of us were left speechless.
It was a miracle far too well-timed.
Could this, too, be part of her "destiny"?
choice_data_list: ...It seems God has answered the angel.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I feel that might be a bit of an exaggeration, though...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It seems I still have things left to do.

Perhaps she will bring us another massive victory
that illuminates everyone from here on.
Strangely enough, that was the feeling I got...
